name: canonical-helper-owner-folders
goal: Colocate helpers within supported source folders while keeping every public SvelteKit route filename fixed.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Keep route filenames fixed because they define public URLs. Colocate route helpers in the existing route directory and the planning API in supported src/lib/planning.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The relocation matrix did not distinguish filesystem-routed entry files from ordinary modules. Freeze canonical owner targets and all seven original public route paths in the same standardized migration guard.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 093c1a36 fails owner-local helper placement for canonical route/API owners. Immutable red 4429d936d5b958d7b4aa2730a22ff55fc51ccb0509f07c641491f49f2d4fd0c2.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Restore every route file to its original location and move its private helpers beside it; use src/lib/planning for the library API owner and retain its public entry.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
